<div class="card-body">
'''Echo Base Trooper Officer''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊エコー基地兵員士官</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならエコー基地兵員は配備コスト－１。自分の兵員／トルーパーは士官がいるホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Echo-Base-Trooper-Officer-PSA-159563452.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の特殊要員のほとんどは、トレイ・ケイラムと同じように脱走してきた元帝国軍士官だ。兵員士官たちは反乱軍の乏しい物資を有効に活用する手腕に優れている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Echo Base trooper officer.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. After that, may move anywhere. Echo Base Troopers deploy -1 to the same location. Your troopers may move as a react toward the same Hoth location as the officer.

'''Lore:'''
Most Rebel specialists, like Trey Callum, are former Imperial officers who defected. Trooper officers are skilled at putting the Rebellion's scarce supplies to good use.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Base Trooper Officer]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
